linesTa: உன் மனம் என்றும் அன்பை இழக்காமல் இருக்கட்டும்.
linesEn: The ocean never grieves that rivers cannot meet;
spring never promises flowers will never fall.
Life is just like that...
How far we will travel,
how long we will walk together,
at which point our roads might branch—
knowing none of this,
we begin our journey.
On this long voyage called life,
so many faces pass by...
Some become memories,
some bonds become lessons,
some encounters turn into stories...
But a few rare people
transform the very meaning of our existence.
Who we become to each other
is not decided by time—
it is shaped by the love born the moment we met,
and the memories that live on forever.
Some meetings are not forever,
some bonds need no labels,
some partings cannot be avoided...
Yet, that does not make them any less beautiful.
For moonlight does not belong to the night;
even as it passes, it leaves behind
its gentle glow upon the darkness.
So it is with a few souls...
More than how long they stayed,
it is how deeply beautiful they made that time
that remains etched in our hearts.
One day, everything will draw to a close...
the days, the distances,
even our very presence will slowly melt
into the gentle hands of time.
Yet, on some page of this vast life,
we were there for each other...
In laughter through shared moments,
in quiet comfort when words fell short,
in silent companionship through unspoken feelings—
what a breathtaking truth that is!
Life is not only about achieving everything;
it is about cherishing what we have,
embracing what has passed,
and loving the people given to us with all our heart.
So live without fearing time...
love without hesitating over distance...
rejoice in memories without regret...
Live every single day
as a poem that will never come again.
Happy Birthday, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜!
May every new chapter of your life
bring new meanings, beautiful souls,
and unexpected joys.
On the roads you walk,
whether spring blooms or autumn leaves fall,
may your heart always see and cherish
the beauty in every season.
May your dreams seek you out,
may your steps open new horizons,
and may your spirit never lose its boundless love.
Where we will be tomorrow,
how far apart we may stand,
how many memories we will carry—
those are questions only time can answer...
But today,
in this golden moment of life,
as we celebrate your birthday,
one truth shines bright and certain:
Out of countless crossroads in this vast universe,
the fact that our paths crossed one day
is one of the most beautiful poems
time has ever gifted us! ♡
Some people don't just walk into your life,
they make life itself beautiful.
Since you arrived,
even our simplest, quietest days
turn into little celebrations.
Without weighing my thoughts,
without questioning my silences,
you accept me just as I am.
In your presence,
I never have to pretend —
I always feel like I've come home.
One minute a song,
the next deep philosophy,
the next a burst of silly laughter with no reason at all.
From crazy thoughts to secret dreams,
even after hours of talking,
there is still a million things left to say.
Maybe that's the magic between us:
a conversation that never has an ending.

titleEn: The Last Bite of Ice Cream
linesEn: They say true friendship is measured in the little things:
The quiet ear when my mind gets too loud,
the inside jokes nobody else will ever understand,
and the laughter that doubles just because we're together.
I would even share my last bite of the ice cream with you,
Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜.
"Thank you" is far too small a word
to hold what your presence truly means.
The warmth you give without even trying,
the light you bring into every room,
all of it together makes my world so much brighter.
I'm so lucky to have you in my life, babe ✨
